insight.headline: GraphQL Admin API Error
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change starts in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their GraphQL queries to handle the new error response. They should also ensure that their metafields are properly set up for filtering. This change may break existing queries, so thorough testing is necessary. The GraphQL Admin API is a crucial part of the Shopify ecosystem, and this change affects all developers using it, including those working with Hydrogen, Remix/React Router, and Polaris.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants may notice improved accuracy in their store's data, as incorrect results are now properly handled. However, they may also encounter errors if their existing queries are not updated to handle the new error response.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the overall reliability and accuracy of the GraphQL Admin API, which is essential for building robust and trustworthy Shopify apps. It also highlights the importance of proper metafield setup and error handling in GraphQL queries.
insight.code_example: query { products(filter: { metafield: { key: "my_metafield", value: "my_value" } }) { edges { node { id } } } }

updates.title: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers
updates.summary: POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API (shopify.printing).

updates.summary: The GraphQL Admin API now returns errors for invalid metafield queries, starting in API version 2026-10.

updates.title: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events
updates.summary: Metafield triggers and additional topics are now available for Events, allowing apps to subscribe to events for various resources and metafield changes.

updates.title: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials
updates.summary: Liquid templates can now compose pages with blocks and partials, simplifying theme page building.

updates.title: Full-stack capabilities to power app analytics
updates.summary: Full-stack capabilities are now available to power app analytics, simplifying the process of building merchant-facing analytics.

updates.title: Physical inventory feature preview
updates.summary: The physical inventory feature preview provides early access to new inventory APIs in the unstable version of the GraphQL Admin API.
The CLI version 4.5.2 fixes a warning when running theme commands in valid theme directories and bumps Shopify/theme-tools packages.

updates.title: Card deposit endpoint now requires mTLS certificate
updates.summary: The card deposit endpoint now requires a Shopify-issued mTLS client certificate, affecting apps that store cardholder data.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance POS UI extensions and GraphQL Admin API

themes.title: POS UI Extensions
themes.detail: The Printing API (shopify.printing) is introduced in POS UI Extensions 2026-07, allowing extensions to discover and print directly to hardware receipt printers using getPrinters(). This update streamlines the printing process for merchants.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Improvements
themes.detail: Starting in API version 2026-10, the GraphQL Admin API will return errors for invalid metafield queries, preventing incorrect results. This change improves data accuracy and reliability for developers using the GraphQL Admin API.

actions.text: Update POS UI extensions to use the new Printing API
Test and adapt GraphQL Admin API queries for metafield changes
